summary.headline: Wave Height chart now supports a 7-day range
summary.detail: Wave Height chart now supports a 7-day range view. Data is sourced from buoy telemetry feeds at 15-minute intervals, improving trend visibility for surf forecasters.

contextRefs.excerpt: Wave height chart 7-day range support requested by forecast team.
Add 7-day range toggle to WaveHeightChart component.

summary.headline: Currents & Drifts adds a red Rip Current status pill
summary.detail: Currents & Drifts panel now displays a red Rip Current status pill when rip current danger index exceeds threshold 7. Improves at-a-glance safety awareness for lifeguards.

contextRefs.excerpt: Request to add rip current status pill from the surf safety channel.
Add red Rip Current status pill to Currents & Drifts panel.
